questions.question: An account holds R250; three debit orders of R180 go off, then R500 is deposited. Write one expression and find the final balance.
Why is the change from −9 °C to 6 °C equal to 15 °C and not 3 °C?
questions.expected_answer: Change is finish minus start: 6 − (−9) = 6 + 9 = 15. Subtracting the negative start adds the two distances from zero.

questions.question: State the four moves for solving an integer problem in context.
questions.expected_answer: State a sign convention; translate the story into one expression with brackets around negatives; evaluate using the order of operations; interpret the result as a sentence with a unit.
